║                 YT DOWNLOADER - QUICK START                    ║

DOWNLOAD & RUN IN 3 STEPS:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. DOWNLOAD
   → Download "START-YTDownloader.bat" 
   → Save it to your desired location

2. DOUBLE-CLICK
   → Double-click "START-YTDownloader.bat"
   → Let the script set up everything automatically

3. WAIT & ENJOY
   → Application will open in your browser
   → Start downloading videos!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT THE SCRIPT DOES:
✓ Checks for Node.js (installs if needed)
✓ Installs all dependencies
✓ Builds the application
✓ Opens http://localhost:3000 in your browser

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
• Windows 7 or later
• 2GB RAM minimum
• 500MB free disk space
• Internet connection (for first setup)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Q: Do I need to install anything?
A: Only the first time! Node.js will be installed automatically if needed.

Q: Where are my downloaded videos?
A: Downloaded videos will be saved to your Downloads folder by default.

Q: Can I use on other computers?
A: Yes! Just copy the .bat file and run it on other Windows computers.

Q: What if the browser doesn't open automatically?
A: Just visit http://localhost:3000 in your browser manually.

Q: How do I stop the server?
A: Press Ctrl+C in the command window.

Q: Can I close the command window?
A: No, keep it open while using the app. The window = the server.

Q: It's showing "Port 3000 in use"?
A: Another app is using port 3000. Kill other servers or restart your PC.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
